extraction.Name: Sophia Giago
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want a patent in fee to her land, and really did not know what she was signing when she signed for it, for she can not read nor write
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold 160 acres to J. C. Berzina, Alliance, Nebr. for $800.00, to pay the taxes on the other 160 acres
extraction.Buyer: J. C. Berzina, Alliance, Nebr. for $800.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: sold 160 acres to pay the taxes on the other 160 acres, and for the last two years she has been unable to pay the taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: supported by her son, Joe Giago, who farms a little but is sick and unable to do much
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, in poor health, having bad eyes and a bad heart that continually causes her trouble; has one minor daughter depending on her for support; has received no assistance from the Government, State or County since she was granted a patent in fee; has 160 acres of land remaining; document sworn November 28, 1928
